sources.note: Nearest first-hand phonological sketch: Nuoxi Yao (naxi1247) is the adjacent, closely related Kam variety spoken by ethnic Yao just across the county line from Lianmin; its 语音 section is the best proxy and may mention the Suining Yao explicitly (绥宁县 is in its subject list).

sources.note: Book-length treatment of Nuoxi Yao (and Cao Miao etc.) with phonology chapters; may discuss the Suining (Lianmin/Shuikou/Jinwu) Yao as part of the same speech community.
